title: 第93章 赵素梅产子
content_zh:
第93章 赵素梅产子-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

上一章

存书签

下一章

林国强把三轮车推到门口，车厢里铺了两层棉被。

赵素梅被扶着坐上去，半靠着被垛。

林静抱着布偶兔子从后院跑出来，林薇被孙小丽牵着，两个闺女都不知道发生了什么，只知道娘脸色不好。

“志军，你骑车载着静静和薇薇。”

“好嘞。”

两辆车一前一后往镇西头的卫生院去。

十月的天已经凉了，路边的杨树叶子黄了一半，风一吹哗啦啦往下掉。

林国强把车蹬得飞快，赵素梅攥着车帮子的手有些发汗。

“国强……”

“在呢。”

“这胎比前两个都疼。”

“卫生院马上就到。”

他没有回头，但赵素梅看见他的后背，衬衫湿了一大片。

产房的门关上了。

林国强坐在走廊的长椅上，两只手搭在膝盖上，心提到了嗓子眼处。

林静靠在他左边，林薇靠在他右边。

赵志军蹲在墙角，隔一会儿就抬头看看产房的门。

走廊里安静得只剩下日光灯嗡嗡的电流声。

偶尔产房里传出一声闷哼，林国强的手就攥紧一分。

林静仰起头：“爸，妈咋了？”

“妈给你们生弟弟呢。”

“弟弟啥时候出来？”

“快了。”

一个多小时后，赵德厚和王桂兰赶到了。

王桂兰走得急，布鞋上全是土，看见林国强就问：“进去多久了？”

“快两个钟头了。”

王桂兰双手合十祈祷。

赵德厚蹲到墙根，掏出旱烟袋又塞回去了。

卫生院不让抽烟。

又过了四十分钟，产房里传出一声婴儿的啼哭。

中气十足，走廊里听得清清楚楚。

王桂兰的眼泪当时就下来了。

赵德厚腾地站起来，旱烟袋掉地上都没察觉。

林静从椅子上滑下来，跑到产房门口踮着脚尖往里看。

门开了。

护士抱着一个襁褓出来。

“母子平安，六斤二两。”

Lin Guoqiang pushed the tricycle to the door. There were two layers of quilts in the carriage.

Zhao Sumei was helped to sit up, half leaning on the quilt.

Lin Jing ran out of the backyard with a stuffed rabbit in her arms, and Lin Wei was led by Sun Xiaoli. The two girls didn't know what happened, but they only knew that their mother looked bad.

"Zhijun, take Jingjing and Weiwei on your bike."

"Okay."

The two cars went to the health center at the west end of the town, one behind the other.

It's already cold in October, and half of the leaves of the poplar trees on the roadside have turned yellow, and they fall off when the wind blows.

Lin Guoqiang pedaled the car very fast, and Zhao Sumei's hand holding the driver's side became sweaty.

"Guoqiang..."

"Here."

"This tire hurts more than the previous two."

"The health center will be here soon."

He didn't look back, but Zhao Sumei saw his back and his shirt was wet.

The door to the delivery room was closed.

Lin Guoqiang sat on the bench in the corridor, his hands on his knees, his heart in his throat.

Lin Jing leaned on his left side, and Lin Wei leaned on his right side.

Zhao Zhijun squatted in the corner and looked up at the door of the delivery room after a while.

The corridor was so quiet that only the buzzing sound of the fluorescent lights was left.

Occasionally, a muffled groan came from the delivery room, and Lin Guoqiang's hands tightened.

Lin Jing raised her head: "Dad, what's wrong with mom?"

"Mom is giving birth to a brother for you."

"When will brother come out?"

"Soon."

More than an hour later, Zhao Dehou and Wang Guilan arrived.

Wang Guilan walked in a hurry, and her cloth shoes were covered with dirt. When she saw Lin Guoqiang, she asked, "How long have you been in there?"

"Almost two hours."

Wang Guilan put her hands together and prayed.

Zhao Dehou squatted down at the base of the wall, took out his dry tobacco bag and stuffed it back.

Smoking is not allowed in the health center.

Another forty minutes later, a baby's cry came from the delivery room.

It was so powerful that it could be heard clearly in the corridor.

Wang Guilan's tears fell immediately.

Zhao Dehou stood up so quickly that he didn't even notice that the dry pipe dropped to the ground.

Lin Jing slid off the chair, ran to the door of the delivery room and stood on tiptoes to look in.

The door opened.

The nurse came out holding a swaddle.

"Mother and child are safe, six pounds and two taels."
